title: High Earners
description: List all employees earning more than 60000. Return all columns.
reference_query: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, department, salary, manager_id FROM employee WHERE salary > 60000;

title: HR Employees
description: List names of employees working in the HR department.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE department = 'HR';

title: Engineering Employees
description: List all employees working in the Engineering department.
reference_query: SELECT emp_id, emp_name FROM employee WHERE department = 'Engineering';

title: Employees Without Manager
description: List employees who do not have a manager.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE manager_id IS NULL;

title: Low Salary Employees
description: List employees earning less than 60000.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employee WHERE salary < 60000;

title: Sales Department
description: List all employees from the Sales department.
reference_query: SELECT emp_id, emp_name FROM employee WHERE department = 'Sales';

title: Managers Only
description: List employees who are managers (have at least one subordinate).
reference_query: SELECT DISTINCT m.emp_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Exact Salary
description: List employees earning exactly 60000.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE salary = 60000;

title: Salary Range
description: List employees earning between 60000 and 80000 inclusive.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employee WHERE salary BETWEEN 60000 AND 80000;

title: Engineering High Earners
description: List employees from Engineering earning more than 80000.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE department='Engineering' AND salary>80000;

title: Non-HR Employees
description: List employees not working in HR.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE department <> 'HR';

title: Employees With Manager
description: List employees who have a manager assigned.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL;

title: High Paid Non-Managers
description: List employees earning more than 70000 who are not managers.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE salary>70000 AND manager_id IS NOT NULL;

title: Marketing Salary Filter
description: List Marketing employees earning at least 70000.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employee WHERE department='Marketing' AND salary>=70000;

title: Above Average Salary
description: List employees earning more than the average salary.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employee WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employee);

title: Department Average Filter
description: List employees earning more than the average salary of their department.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, department, salary FROM employee e WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employee WHERE department = e.department);

title: Top 2 Salaries
description: List employees earning one of the top two distinct salaries.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employee WHERE salary IN (SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 2);

title: Department Max Earners
description: List employees earning the maximum salary in their department.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, department FROM employee e WHERE salary = (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employee WHERE department=e.department);

title: No Subordinates
description: List employees who do not manage anyone.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT manager_id FROM employee WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL);

title: Salary Rank Top Half
description: List employees earning more than the median salary.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employee WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM (SELECT salary FROM employee ORDER BY salary LIMIT 4 OFFSET 2));

title: Employee Count
description: Find the total number of employees.
reference_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM employee;

title: Average Salary
description: Find the average salary of all employees.
reference_query: SELECT AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employee;

title: Maximum Salary
description: Find the highest salary among employees.
reference_query: SELECT MAX(salary) AS max_salary FROM employee;

title: Minimum Salary
description: Find the lowest salary among employees.
reference_query: SELECT MIN(salary) AS min_salary FROM employee;

title: Salary Sum
description: Calculate total salary paid to all employees.
reference_query: SELECT SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employee;

title: Department Count
description: Count number of employees per department.
reference_query: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM employee GROUP BY department;

title: Department Average Salary
description: Find average salary per department.
reference_query: SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employee GROUP BY department;

title: Department Max Salary
description: Find highest salary per department.
reference_query: SELECT department, MAX(salary) AS max_salary FROM employee GROUP BY department;

title: Departments With Multiple Employees
description: List departments having more than one employee.
reference_query: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM employee GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

title: Departments With High Average Salary
description: List departments where average salary exceeds 70000.
reference_query: SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employee GROUP BY department HAVING AVG(salary) > 70000;

title: Total Salary By Department
description: Show total salary paid by each department.
reference_query: SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employee GROUP BY department;

title: Employee Count Above Threshold
description: List departments with more than 2 employees.
reference_query: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM employee GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

title: Salary Variance Per Department
description: Find difference between max and min salary per department.
reference_query: SELECT department, MAX(salary) - MIN(salary) AS salary_diff FROM employee GROUP BY department;

title: Departments With Salary Sum Above Limit
description: List departments where total salary exceeds 150000.
reference_query: SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employee GROUP BY department HAVING SUM(salary) > 150000;

title: Average Salary Of Managers
description: Find average salary of employees who are managers.
reference_query: SELECT AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employee WHERE emp_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT manager_id FROM employee WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL);

title: Department Salary Ranking
description: Rank departments by average salary in descending order.
reference_query: SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employee GROUP BY department ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

title: Employees Above Department Average
description: Count employees earning above their department average.
reference_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM employee e WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employee WHERE department=e.department);

title: Department With Highest Average Salary
description: Find department having the highest average salary.
reference_query: SELECT department FROM employee GROUP BY department ORDER BY AVG(salary) DESC LIMIT 1;

title: Manager Count
description: Count number of managers.
reference_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT manager_id) AS manager_count FROM employee WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL;

title: Median Salary Approximation
description: Find approximate median salary using average of middle salaries.
reference_query: SELECT AVG(salary) AS median_salary FROM (SELECT salary FROM employee ORDER BY salary LIMIT 4 OFFSET 2);

title: Employee Manager Names
description: List employee names along with their manager names.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name AS employee, m.emp_name AS manager FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Employees With Managers
description: List employees who have a manager.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Manager Employee Pairs
description: Show manager and employee pairs.
reference_query: SELECT m.emp_name AS manager, e.emp_name AS employee FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Employees Without Managers
description: List employees without managers.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name FROM employee WHERE manager_id IS NULL;

title: Employee Department
description: List employee names with their departments.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, department FROM employee;

title: Managers Only
description: List names of managers.
reference_query: SELECT DISTINCT m.emp_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Employee Salary With Manager
description: Show employee salary with manager name.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name, e.salary, m.emp_name AS manager FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Manager Count Using Join
description: Count distinct managers using join.
reference_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.emp_id) AS manager_count FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Employees Earning Less Than Manager
description: List employees earning less than their manager.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name, e.salary FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.salary < m.salary;

title: Manager Salary Comparison
description: Show employee and manager salaries side by side.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name AS employee, e.salary AS emp_salary, m.emp_name AS manager, m.salary AS mgr_salary FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Employees With Same Department As Manager
description: List employees whose department matches their manager's department.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.department = m.department;

title: Manager Employee Count
description: Count number of employees reporting to each manager.
reference_query: SELECT m.emp_name AS manager, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_name;

title: Employees With Higher Salary Than Manager Average
description: List employees earning more than average manager salary.
reference_query: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employee WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employee WHERE emp_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT manager_id FROM employee WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL));

title: Employee Manager Department
description: List employee names with manager department.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name, m.department AS manager_department FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id;

title: Managers With More Than One Report
description: List managers having more than one direct report.
reference_query: SELECT m.emp_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

title: Highest Paid Employee Per Manager
description: Find highest paid employee reporting to each manager.
reference_query: SELECT m.emp_name AS manager, MAX(e.salary) AS max_salary FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_name;

title: Managers With Higher Salary Than Reports
description: List managers earning more than all their direct reports.
reference_query: SELECT m.emp_name FROM employee m JOIN employee e ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_name HAVING MAX(e.salary) < m.salary;

title: Employees Sharing Manager
description: List pairs of employees sharing the same manager.
reference_query: SELECT e1.emp_name AS emp1, e2.emp_name AS emp2 FROM employee e1 JOIN employee e2 ON e1.manager_id = e2.manager_id WHERE e1.emp_id < e2.emp_id AND e1.manager_id IS NOT NULL;

title: Manager With Highest Team Salary
description: Find manager whose team has the highest total salary.
reference_query: SELECT m.emp_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_name ORDER BY SUM(e.salary) DESC LIMIT 1;

title: Employees Earning Less Than Department Manager
description: List employees earning less than their department manager.
reference_query: SELECT e.emp_name, e.salary FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.salary < m.salary;
